record.body:
## Rationale

Versions are not managed yet (unreleased dogfood). A compat gate or AA `--version` without a release process is ceremony. Defer version-compat-check and version-tag-releases until an actual release process is chosen.

## Counter-argument

A report-only `se-workflow --version` that prints both versions would still help debug mismatched installs today, without enforcement. That can wait; install debugging has other signals (resolve errors, contract drift).
record.subject: defer-versioning-until-release-process
